critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1837 lines - urgently split into modules (auth/reports/import/notifications/tax) for maintainability.

_compute_vat_breakdown treats missing vat_rate as 0 (`float(it.get('vat_rate') or 0)`) instead of the model default 20. This works because Pydantic default is applied on read for API responses, but if a legacy Mongo doc has vat_rate missing and is aggregated raw (bypassing Pydantic), it would be counted at 0%. Consider defaulting to 20 explicitly in the aggregation.
Tax endpoints have no upper bound on date range; `find(...).to_list(5000)` can silently truncate at 5000 records for large tenants.
The /reports/tax response does not include the currency; frontend assumes TRY. Fine for now but document.
Frontend/pages/Incomes.jsx missed adding the Select import when vat_rate select was added — indicative of a missed lint step in the dev workflow.
